name: VeriSwarm Guard
description: Trust scoring, PII tokenization, policy enforcement, and audit for OpenClaw agents. Protects against data exposure, prompt injection, and unauthorized tool usage.

agentId.description: Agent ID for this OpenClaw instance

agentKey.description: Agent API key (agta_...) for credential issuance and self-reporting

piiEnabled.description: Enable PII tokenization on outbound messages and tool-call params

injectionScan.description: Enable prompt injection scanning on tool outputs

auditEnabled.description: Enable audit logging to VeriSwarm Vault

allowedTools.description: Only these tools allowed (allowlist mode). Empty = allow all.

secretsDetection.description: Block tool calls and cancel outbound messages that contain provider-prefix secrets (values or keys). When off (default), secrets in tool params and outbound messages are redacted locally instead (a call whose top-level parameter name is a secret is still blocked). Either way secrets are never sent to the VeriSwarm API, and secrets in tool results are always redacted locally.

sessionScan.description: Enable Session Sentry multi-turn exfiltration detection. Each outbound message is submitted to /v1/suite/guard/scan-session; if the conversation-level risk score triggers a block, delivery of the message is cancelled. An API error also cancels delivery unless failOpen is set. Safe to leave on while the platform flag is dormant — the server returns {enabled:false, blocked:false}. Default: true.

failOpen.description: Let tool calls and messages through without PII tokenization or Session Sentry when the VeriSwarm API is unreachable or returns an unexpected response, and let them through unchecked when a Guard hook fails unexpectedly. Default false: the tool call is blocked, the message delivery cancelled, or the tool result withheld. Local secret redaction and blocks need no API and are not relaxed by this flag.
